description: Call this tool to write a new PDF with pages in the order you give. The order must name every page exactly once, so nothing drops by accident; use pdf_pages for a subset. Pro.

order.description: The 1-based page numbers in their new order, e.g. [3,1,2] for a three-page file. Every page must appear exactly once

out_path.description: Name for the reordered PDF; it comes back as a download link valid for one hour

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

path.description: Name of an uploaded PDF (pdf_upload), or one this server wrote earlier

name: pdf_reorder
title: Reorder the pages of a PDF
